title: Held When You Fall
story:
A little boy was learning to ride his bicycle without training wheels.

At first, he was nervous.

His father ran beside him, keeping a hand close to the back of the bicycle.

The boy managed to ride several meters before losing his balance and falling onto the grass.

He expected his father to be disappointed.

Instead, his father helped him stand, checked that he was okay, and said, "Let's try again. I'm right here."

The boy realized that falling did not mean the journey was over.

His father's presence gave him the courage to get back on the bicycle.

Our walk with God can sometimes feel the same.

We may stumble, make mistakes, or go through difficult seasons.

But God does not abandon us when we fall.

He holds us by the hand, helps us rise, and gives us strength to continue.

A fall may be part of the journey, but it does not have to be the end.

When we trust God, we can get up again because His hand is holding us.
life_lesson: You may stumble or fall, but God will not abandon you. He holds you, helps you rise, and gives you strength to keep moving forward.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for holding me when I stumble.

When I make mistakes or face difficult moments, help me remember that You have not abandoned me.

Give me courage to rise again and continue walking with You.

Strengthen my faith and help me trust Your hand even when the path is difficult.

Thank You for always being near me.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Is there a failure or difficult experience that has made you afraid to try again?

Do you believe that God is still holding you even when you stumble?

What step can you take today to get back up and continue with God?
verse: Though he may stumble, he will not fall, for the Lord upholds him with His hand.
